mods.name: Set Clock
mods.author: Kyle-Hosman
mods.summary: The time of day and how long your set has been running, large and readable, on its own Mod Menu page.
mods.description:
A page under Mod Menu > Community Mods > Installed > Set Clock: the time of day and the time since the set started, in big digits.

The set starts when a deck first has a track loaded and carries on through a reload; reset it from the page (press twice).

The deck's clock is UTC, so the page has a time zone setting in 15 minute steps (daylight saving is not applied), and a 12- or 24-hour clock.

It reads only the clock and whether a track is loaded: no hooks, controls, LEDs, audio, files or network.
